claim: The per-facet inequality of certified-special-case-check-6 is unproved and its measured margin falls with the complexity of the cell. This run searches for a facet where it fails, in a complexity band above the one already measured, and reports the margin per band with the median beside the minimum.
approved: independent review of 2026-09-05, ACCEPT WITH AMENDMENTS, recorded in ../../ADMISSION.md; amendments 1 to 8 are incorporated here
checkpoint condition: either a failing facet, with its cell, triple, facet and the breaking ray, or a new band of cells of more than 684 edges holding at least 20 cells and at least 2000 facet ray tests
sources: the eight recorded tightest cells of certified-special-case-check-6, 364 to 666 edges, retested with per-facet detail
generic points of the hive cone, vertex cap raised from 320 to 600
perturbations of the certified box triples, so that edge count and construction route are separated
records per tested facet: the number of negative edges on it
the worst ratio over the cell's extreme rays
statistics: per band, floor power of two of the cell's edge count, over old and new data together: cells, facet ray tests, worst ratio, median of the per-cell worst ratios; the median is the headline
allowance: one run of at most 40 minutes wall time, single threaded, trial runs included; a no-hit outcome is recorded as undecided and does not replenish it
not claimed: no number of passing facets proves the inequality
